title: Page 83
transc:
Washn D. C. Nov 5th 1862 1230 PM
For Alpha or Paulding Oquorum Emery
The Springs will first repair to
Flint and await a convoying ship
not yet determined what Grants will
be sent with these Stanhope Austria


3 PM  Wash DC Nov 5th 1862
G. W. Skinner La Grange Miss
For Bremen Had not troops sent
to reinforce you better go to
Torrent here after? I hope to
give you twenty thousand <insertion>(20,000)</insertion> additional men
in a few days Alden Fanny
